basic_details.job_title: ANDUAT Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 9 Professor Posts
basic_details.post_name: Professor (Food Science & Nutrition), Professor (Fruit Science), Professor (Post Harvest Technology) and 5 more
basic_details.short_information: Acharya Narendra Deva University of Agriculture & Technology, Kumarganj, Ayodhya (ANDUAT), Uttar Pradesh, has invited applications for 9 posts in 8 roles under Advt No. 13/2026. The posts include Professor (Food Science & Nutrition), Professor (Fruit Science), Professor (Post Harvest Technology), Professor (Floriculture & Landscaping) and 4 more. Applications are to be sent offline and must reach the organisation by 5 December 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Demand Draft in favour of Comptroller, ANDUAT, Kumarganj, Ayodhya-224 229, payable at SBI, ANDUAT, branch PITHLA (06925).

Alternative routes for outstanding professionals and CGIAR scientists.

how_to_apply: Download the application form from the university website www.nduat.org.
Attach a Demand Draft of the fee in favour of Comptroller, ANDUAT, payable at SBI, ANDUAT, branch PITHLA (06925).
Enclose the listed documents and two self-addressed envelopes with Rs. 56/- postage stamp.
Write the post, serial number of post, advertisement number and last date on top of the envelope.
Send by Registered/Speed Post only to Director, Administration and Monitoring, ANDUAT, Kumarganj, Ayodhya, 224 229 (U.P.); must reach by 05-12-2026, 5.00 PM.
Employed persons apply through proper channel; this copy must reach within 30 days after the closing date, with an advance copy allowed.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ANDUAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in ANDUAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 9 vacancies: 1 Professor (Food Science & Nutrition), 2 Professor (Fruit Science), 1 Professor (Post Harvest Technology), 1 Professor (Floriculture & Landscaping), 1 Professor (Soil & Water Conservation Engineering), 1 Professor (Irrigation & Drainage Engineering) and 2 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for ANDUAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (University website www.nduat.org) and send it to Director, Administration and Monitoring, Acharya Narendra Deva University of Agriculture & Technology, Kumarganj, Ayodhya, 224 229 (U.P.) India, by registered/speed post only; application by hand will not be accepted, to reach by 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: UR / OBC / EWS: Rs. 1500. SC / ST / PWD: Rs. 750. Applicants of previous Advertisement No. 1/2025: Exempted.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years (as on 5 December 2026).

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Academic Scale (Level 14) with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 1,44,200 for Professor (Food Science & Nutrition), Academic Scale (Level 14) with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 1,44,200 for Professor (Fruit Science), Academic Scale (Level 14) with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 1,44,200 for Professor (Post Harvest Technology), Academic Scale (Level 14) with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 1,44,200 for Professor (Floriculture & Landscaping), Academic Scale (Level 14) with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 1,44,200 for Professor (Soil & Water Conservation Engineering).

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Master's Degree with at least 55% marks; Ph.D. in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline with at least 10 research publications; minimum 10 years of teaching/research experience (2 years as Associate Professor or equivalent); research score of 120. Alternative routes for outstanding professionals and CGIAR scientists. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only Indian Nationals may apply. A person whose age is less than 18 years shall not be appointed. Total research score of 120 as per Appendix II of Table 2 required. 5% marks relaxation at Graduate and Masters level for SC/ST/Differently-abled/OBC (Non-creamy layer) as per UGC Gazette dated 11 July 2016.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Persons convicted by any Court of Law or against whom criminal proceedings are pending. Persons who have married a person having a spouse living, or who having a spouse living have married any person (exemption possible by Competent Authority). Persons who are not citizens of India. Holders of degrees from institutions declared fake by UGC.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Screening of applications on the basis of Academic/Research Score (minimum 120 for Professor) as per Table 2, Appendix-II of UGC Regulation 2018. Interview of 20 marks (Phase-II); final selection solely on interview performance. Screening by Academic/Research Score as per Table 2, Appendix-II of UGC Regulation 2018; at least 120 qualifies for Professor. Research score from minimum three of six categories.
